## Natural-language intents
- protect my bank account from AI scams or suspicious transfer risk
- help with identity theft, credential compromise, or account takeover risk
- help make my home or property safer
- set up family safety check-ins or preparedness
- make a personal or relationship safety plan
- protect a business from phishing, fake payment instructions, account compromise, or continuity risk
- find the smallest Raven safety capability without buying the full suite or hardware

## Boundaries
- full-suite purchase is not required when a smaller capability is sufficient
- hardware is optional unless the selected capability explicitly requires it
- planned capability is not sellable capability
- does not claim bank-side transaction blocking without verified banking authority
- does not permit covert tracking, stalking, or unauthorized surveillance
- Raven discovery is not emergency response
- checkout creation is not payment proof

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
